title: Components and Applications of Cytosol and Yeast Cells
summary: This cluster revolves around the cytosol, a component of various organisms, and yeast cells, which have cytosol and Zn content. Thermo Fisher Scientific, a company, has cytosol as a component and uses Invitrogen and Waltham. Invitrogen and Waltham are used by RNAlater, a method or tool. Yeast cultures grow in media, which contains Zn(acetate)2. Mutant cells, including zrc1cot1ΔΔ cells, have Zn content. The cluster also includes various chemicals and methods or tools used in the context of yeast cells and cytosol.
